verdict: existing APIs bound individual requests and retained queries, not total cold contract-sync work; staged supported implementation is feasible but needs explicit partial-sync semantics
authorization: Routine synchronization engineering is authorized by standing task; prior diagnosis wording No synchronization patch authorized is obsolete and is not a blocker. No source/dependency changes performed in this investigation.

sourceFindings.finding: sync() synchronizes block metadata/reorg state. getPrivateEvents runs ensureContractSynced BEFORE validating/applying event block range; autoSync:false only suppresses pre-operation block sync, not contract discovery. readPreferenceHead via utility can also trigger contract sync before the first page.

syncChainTip selects proposed/checkpointed/proven/finalized, and l2BlockBatchSize caps one stream request. No exposed arbitrary historical step anchor or resumable contract-sync API was found. Lowering the reported node tip is not a supported authenticated recovery bound.

MAX_RPC_LEN100, MAX_LOGS_PER_TAG20 and afterLog provide real pagination primitives. The all-pages helpers drain every page, accumulate arrays, and launch all tag batches with allToCompletion. Per-request pagination is not a total call/allocation bound.

All eligible secrets are enumerated and tags allocated, then windows advance until exhausted; allLogs grows across rounds. Work is finite for a fixed honest finite archive but scales with history/secret fan-out; no history-independent work or RSS budget. Constrained gap termination and finalized/aged indices help steady state, not arbitrary keys-only backlog.

Note nullifier synchronization materializes scoped active notes. Event commitment recomputation, contract-siloed nullifier membership, authenticated transaction/block metadata and stable event ordering are mandatory. Directly seeding PrivateEventStore does not measure this path.

Operations drain speculative/nested contributors before atomic commit or abort. Sync cache promises mean complete synchronization. Reorg rollback and anchor update are atomic; recipient finalized/aged indices are intentionally nonrollbackable. Throwing at a work cap aborts progress; returning a truncated log list risks falsely marking complete.

smallestMeasurement.step1: Add bounded aggregate-only timing and actual method/page/byte/high-water counters to the existing genuine five-proof relationships recovery campaign. Distinguish PXE construction/block sync, first head utility/ensureContractSynced, first event query, subsequent pages and fold. Repeat the keys-only read in a fresh namespace and empty AEAD preference store using only original in-RAM keys; do not seed event store or bypass official authentication. No additional proof actions are needed beyond existing campaign.
smallestMeasurement.step2: Before expensive execution, use a small offline official-helper test with dense one-tag21/41 log pages and multiple secrets to demonstrate request-count growth, array retention and cursor progress. Label synthetic; it tests bounded-work mechanics, not encrypted discovery. A cap+abort-only variant must show rollback and cannot claim resumable progress.
smallestMeasurement.step3: After measurement, genuine encrypted discovery at increasing history requires actual authenticated history from a retained disposable chain or a new bounded generation campaign. Existing50k retained-store fixtures are not substitutes. Do not fabricate a50k real-proof test inside540s; grow measured1/3-event baseline first and schedule separately bounded later stages.
smallestMeasurement.costAndTime: No paid resource is required for source/mechanics work. Existing genuine five-proof campaign has roughly7-minute precedent within540s/4GiB; an added fresh recovery must be admitted only with measured remaining budget, otherwise a separate bounded recovery stage against retained owned services is needed. Larger encrypted-history proof costs/time are unmeasured; no reliable50k estimate is available.
smallestMeasurement.output: Fixed phases, counts, bytes, elapsed wall+monotonic times, process/tree memory, source/artifact hashes, completeness/error category and owned cleanup. Keep tags, secrets, decrypted events, account and relationship identifiers out of public reports. Preserve host-sleep evidence and partial stage checkpoints.

implementationRoute.phaseA: Smallest safe first change: replace eager unbounded batch concurrency with bounded scheduling and pre-allocation byte/work checks while keeping full completion/atomic semantics. This can reduce peak memory and fail clearly but alone does NOT satisfy resumable cold ingestion. Measure it separately.
implementationRoute.phaseB: Add explicit scoped sync-step API inside the existing PXE operation queue. Return incomplete with opaque encrypted continuation or complete; ordinary utility/simulation must remain fenced until all required scopes/contracts are complete at the actual captured canonical anchor. Never mark syncedContracts complete on a partial step.
implementationRoute.phaseC: Resume at authenticated phase boundaries: paginated handshake/secret discovery; per-secret/window/tag/afterLog retrieval; original Noir processing and event/note validation; scoped nullifier scan. Commit only fully validated staged notes/events plus their continuation together. Cache raw downloaded pages privately only if they are not treated as authenticated state. If current Noir sync_state cannot safely yield, extend that utility/oracle contract explicitly rather than truncate its existing all-logs result.
implementationRoute.phaseD: Bind continuation to chain/rollup, contract+class, caller scope, schema and canonical anchor hash. Preserve finalized/aged index meaning; add rollbackable tentative cursor state rather than advancing irreversible indices past unprocessed data. Detect anchor removal/head changes and roll back/restart the affected prefix. Keep ordinary sync defaults unchanged.
implementationRoute.bounds: Propose configurable initial test budgets: one scope, max2 concurrently owned reads, max100 tags/request, max20 logs/tag/page, max1MiB decoded payload per step, max512 validated events/step, explicit secret/note scan pages. These are engineering starting points, not qualified product limits. Bound work before allocation and drain started operations; cooperative deadline is not an excuse to abandon writers.

acceptance: Differential complete output equality with official unbounded path on finite fixtures and genuine small encrypted history.
Dense same-tag pages, sparse/constrained/unconstrained streams, multiple secrets, nested handshake discovery, active notes/nullifiers and offchain/partial-note contributors.
Bad commitment, wrong contract/scope, missing transaction membership, reordered/duplicate/stalled cursor and overbudget provider pages fail closed.
Crash before/after atomic continuation commit, restart with original keys, account switch/logout while reads pending and no late publication/writes.
Same-height and suffix reorg rollback preserve exact head/digest/read-marker reconstruction; incomplete steps never authorize simulation/send.
Native LMDB and browser IndexedDB cold discovery timing/memory/request bounds measured separately from existing warm retained-store evidence.
Operated-node/archiver retention, capacity and cost remain independent G07-A08 work; no remote/fullnode qualification inferred.
limitations: Read-only source analysis only; no benchmark, browser, native proof, service or dependency mutation.
